subject: ShinySky typeahead with data from server.ui

messages.author: 28effd25446ac5dc
messages.subject: ShinySky typeahead with data from server.ui
parts:
I'm trying to implement the typeahead with a list of words from a dataset accessed through server.ui. I'm not sure how to give a dataframe to the 'local' parameter of typeahead. I'm tried using hotable as my dataframe of choices but I'm getting nowhere. Any help would be appreciated. Thanks.

example ui.R:

textInput.typeahead(

        id='typeahead',

        placeholder='some name',

        local=hotable('hotable1'),

        valueKey = 'name',

        tokens=c(1),

        template = HTML("<p class='repo-name'>{{name}}</p> <p class='repo-description'>test</p>")

    )


example server.R:


output$hotable1 = renderHotable({

     df = data(); # data defined elsewhere

     print(data.frame(name=rownames(df)));

});

messages.subject: Re: ShinySky typeahead with data from server.ui
parts: Do you have to use ShinySky? The selectizeInput control has this functionality built in; see http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/selectize.html, under the section "Server-side selectize".
